permission.title: Your location
permission.body: JoyoFit needs your location to make a loop from where you stand. The location is read on your phone; only the start point of a new route is sent to the routing service when you look for a route.
permission.denied: Location permission was denied. Open settings to allow it, or use your Home point.

home.title: Home point
home.saved: Home is saved on this phone.
home.none: No Home point yet. Save one so loops always start at your door, without needing location.
home.storedLocally: The Home point is stored on this phone only and does not sync to the cloud.
home.pickHint: Tap the map to place Home.
home.locateFailed: Your location could not be read. Try again outdoors, or pick on the map.

findingHint: Paths come from a map service, so this takes a few seconds.
stale: The target or start point changed. Find a route again for {{target}}.

chip.label: {{pct}} percent of this route is on streets you have not been on

result.summary: {{distance}} loop, {{pct}}% on streets you have not painted
result.noHistory: No walk or run tracks of yours around here yet, so new streets cannot be counted.
result.lengthOff: The length is {{percent}}% off the target; the routing service found nothing closer.
result.history_one: {{count}} of your tracks shows on the map as a thin line.
result.history_other: {{count}} of your tracks show on the map as thin lines.

actions.beginHint: Record the {{sport}} on your phone. To follow the line on your watch, send the route to the watch first.

push.needConnect: Connect your watch first to send a route.
push.openRoute: Open the route to rename it

errors.noRoad: There is no street or path to walk on near this start point. Move Home to the nearest street, or try another place.
errors.noLoop: No loop of {{target}} fits around this start: rivers, rails or dead-end streets keep every try far off the length. Try another length or another start.
errors.noLoopLong: No loop of {{target}} fits around this start: rivers, rails or dead-end streets push every path longer. The closest is {{closest}}, {{percent}}% over.
errors.noLoopShort: No loop of {{target}} fits around this start: rivers, rails or dead-end streets cut every path short. The closest is {{closest}}, {{percent}}% under.
errors.busy: The map service is busy or not answering right now, so no route could be built. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: The routing service could not be reached. Check your internet and try again.

privacy: When you look for a route, the start point and points around it are sent to the OSRM routing service (FOSSGIS). Your workout tracks stay on your phone; new streets are counted here.
